admin.aborted_banner: Bahali rok di gayi. Dukaan tab tak maintenance mein rahegi jab tak dobara shuru na karein ya maintenance band karein.
admin.backups_hint: Raat ka database. Abhi ke liye: GitHub → Actions → backup → Run workflow.
admin.delete_offer: Copy chahiye to pehle export karein.
admin.delete_progress: Halat hazf ho rahi hai. Raat ka kaam qatarein hataata hai. Safha tab tak taza rahega jab tak dukaan khatam na ho.
admin.delete_warning: Hazf devices ab mansookh karta hai. Raat ka kaam qatarein aur files hataata hai. Khufia backup 30 din (rozana), 12 mahine (mahana) aur 90 din (GitHub) rakhte hain. Hazf yeh muddat nahi ghatata.
admin.err_server: Server dastiyab nahi. Apna connection check karein aur dobara koshish karein.
admin.err_generic: Kuch ghalat hua. Dobara koshish karein.
admin.err_not_operator: Yeh account console nahi khol sakta.
admin.import_partial: Import ruk gaya: {{rejected}} tabdeeliyan mustarad aur {{missing}} par karwai nahin hui. File mehfooz hai; dukaan ka data durust kar ke dobara koshish karein.
admin.import_hint: Sirf mansookh device. bikri-unsynced JSON file chunein.
admin.import_not_revoked: Sirf is dukaan ke mansookh device ke liye.
admin.import_tenant_mismatch: Yeh file doosri dukaan ki hai.
admin.maintenance_banner: Dukaan maintenance mein hai. Us ke khate maintenance ki ghalti paate hain aur offline farokht jari rehti hai.
admin.maintenance_off_body: Khate phir sync ho sakte hain. Adhoori bahali adhoori rehti hai.
admin.over_80: Aaj ke budget ka 80% se zyada
admin.owner_email_hint: Is pate ko Cloudflare Email Routing destination addresses mein shamil karein taake maalik tasdeeq kar sake.
admin.pin_done: PIN badal gaya. Sirf hash bheja gaya.
admin.pin_reminder: PIN badalne se pehle maalik ki pehchan alag raste se tasdeeq karein.
admin.reason_body: Wajah likhein. Yeh dukaan ki activity mein mehfooz hoti hai.
admin.restore_aborted: Bahali ruk gayi. Dukaan maintenance mein rehti hai.
admin.restore_different_zip: Yeh woh zip nahi jis se bahali shuru hui.
admin.restore_confirm: Main samajhta hoon ke yeh safai export import karne se pehle is dukaan ke maujooda record delete kar degi.
admin.restore_intro: Is dukaan ki export zip chunein. Qadam: maintenance on, safai, import, restore point, maintenance off. Safha dobara kholne par jari rehta hai. Rokne par dukaan maintenance mein rehti hai.
admin.restore_need_file: Jari rakhne ke liye wahi export zip chunein.
admin.restore_stuck: Safai kam nahi hui. Dukaan maintenance mein rehti hai.
admin.restore_wrong_shop: Yeh export doosri dukaan ki hai.
admin.restore_incomplete: Is export mein kuch tables ghayab hain; mehfooz restore mumkin nahin.
admin.revoke_body: Khata sync hona band karta hai aur enrol dikhata hai. Doosri dukanein nahi badalti.
admin.support_body: Dukaan banner dekhti hai jab tak yeh khatam na ho. Code ek bar chalta hai.
admin.support_end_body: Madad ab khatam karein? Dukaan ka banner hat jayega.

admin.new_side_1: Dukan, uski main branch aur kharch ki categories ban jayengi.
admin.new_side_2: 72 ghante ke liye ek baar istemal hone wala pairing code jari hoga.
admin.new_side_3: Malik code ya link se ek admin device jorega.
admin.new_side_4: Malik ka email Cloudflare Email Routing mein shamil karein taake woh verify kar sake.
admin.created_hint: Dukan tayyar hai. Pairing code sirf ek baar dikhaya jata hai.
admin.tenant_status_hint: Maujooda halat, wajah aur tabdeeli karne wala
admin.tenant_actions_hint: Halat, support access aur pairing codes
admin.tenant_usage_hint: Pichhle saat dinon mein likhi gayi qatarein
admin.status_since_never: Dukan banne ke baad se halat tabdeel nahi hui.
admin.devices_subtitle: Is dukan ki devices aur codes
admin.issue_code_hint: Ek code ek device ko is dukan mein jorta hai aur 72 ghante baad khatam ho jata hai.
admin.pin_subtitle: Purana PIN dekhe baghair malik ka PIN tabdeel karein
admin.export_intro: Is dukan ka mukammal data ZIP file mein download karein.
admin.export_hint: File aap ke browser mein banti hai aur dukan ke audit log mein darj hoti hai.
admin.delete_zone_hint: Dukan delete karna wapas nahi ho sakta.
admin.backups_subtitle: Database ki raat ki copies aur downloads
admin.backups_info_body: Har raat database ki mukammal copy banti hai. Foran backup ke liye GitHub → Actions → backup → Run workflow chalayein.
admin.backups_empty_hint: Pehla backup raat ke schedule ya manual workflow ke baad nazar aayega.
admin.pairing_help: Till par link kholein ya enrol screen par yeh code darj karein.
admin.usage_peak: Zyada se zyada {{peak}} rows/day · rozana budget {{budget}} ka {{percent}}%
admin.owner_email_missing: Malik ka email darj nahin. Jab tak aap Edit mein shamil nahin karenge, owner email sign-in aur devices ka intezam kaam nahin karega.
admin.requests_subtitle: Aam darkhwastein dekhein. Email verification aur approval yahan hoti hai.
admin.request_email_hint: Approval se pehle email Cloudflare mein verified honi chahiye. Approval dukan aur us ka registration code banati hai.
admin.request_email_added: Cloudflare ne verification email bhej di.
admin.request_email_not_verified: Abhi verified nahi. Malik se Cloudflare link par click karne ko kahein.
admin.request_email_not_configured: Cloudflare Email Routing configure nahi. Dashboard mein email shamil karein, phir yahan verified darj karein.
admin.request_email_manual_hint: Cloudflare API configure nahi. Cloudflare Email Routing mein email shamil aur verify karein, phir yahan darj karein.
admin.request_verify_first: Pehle email verify karein; Cloudflare ki tasdeeq tak approval band hai.
admin.request_approve_body: {{email}} ke liye dukan “{{shop}}” banayein aur 72 ghante ka malik registration code banayein.
admin.request_slug_budget_hint: Dukan ka slug aur rozana budget default hain. Banne ke baad dukan ke page se badal sakte hain.
admin.request_reject_body: “{{shop}}” ke liye koi dukan nahi banegi. Wajah darkhwast dene wale ko dikhai jayegi.
admin.request_reopen_body: Darkhwast jaize mein wapas jayegi. Agar email verified hai to dobara manzoor ki ja sakti hai.
admin.request_approved: Dukan manzoor. Neeche registration code copy karein.
admin.request_approved_existing: Ye darkhwast pehle hi manzoor hai. Zaroorat ho to dukan ke page se naya malik code jari karein.
admin.request_invite_not_sent: Dukan ban gayi, lekin invite email nahi bhej saki. Neeche link copy kar ke malik ko bhejein.
